prize_count_note: USD 3,700 in cash plus MLH sponsor-technology prizes (Gemini, MongoDB Atlas, Auth0).

criteria.label: Technical difficulty
criteria.description: Hurdles that needed unique solutions; how much heavy lifting external APIs and libraries do.

criteria.label: Uniqueness
criteria.description: Creative and original rather than common at hackathons.

criteria.label: Design
criteria.description: Intuitive user experience, or sophisticated human-computer interaction for hardware.

criteria.label: Completeness
criteria.description: Polished and fully working; goals met without compromise.

judging.judge_profile_summary: 15 judges: engineers from Google, Cohere, TextQL and Mimecast, a Deloitte consultant, a data analyst, a CTO, startup founders (including a YC-backed company) and a student.
judging.notes: Technical difficulty explicitly discounts work done by external APIs and libraries.

submission_requirements: One of Best Game, Best Hardware or Best Beginner per project
